sources.entry: Bichon - Email archiving server that syncs from IMAP accounts, indexes emails for full-text search, and provides a REST API. No external database required, includes WebUI with multi-account support. AGPL-3.0 Rust/Docker

summary.one_liner: Bichon is a self-hosted Rust email archiving server that downloads mail from IMAP accounts, full-text indexes it, and serves a REST API and embedded WebUI.
summary.what_it_does: Bichon connects to one or more IMAP accounts, using password or OAuth 2.0, and downloads messages concurrently, with incremental UID-based syncing and optional per-account schedules set with cron expressions. Downloaded mail is indexed with Tantivy for full-text search, with filters for date, size, attachments, tags, and threads, and a contacts view built from senders and recipients. Raw emails and attachments are stored in a Zstd-compressed blob store, with BLAKE3 content hashing so identical content is stored once. The project provides a REST API with OpenAPI docs, an embedded React WebUI, and multi-user role-based access control. The bichon-cli tool imports EML, MBOX, Thunderbird profiles and PST files and exports MBOX, and bichon-admin handles password reset and migrations from older versions. The optional embedded SMTP server receives mail only; Bichon does not send email.
use_cases: archive IMAP mailboxes for long-term preservation
search across multiple email accounts at once
import old EML, MBOX, PST or Thunderbird mail into an archive
give a team scoped read access to archived email
feed archived mail to scripts through a REST API
how_to_run: cargo run -- --bichon-root-dir /tmp/bichon-data  (build from source; requires Rust, Node.js 20+, pnpm)
notable: Archiver only: it downloads and indexes mail and does not send, compose, or reply
Three embedded storage layers (Tantivy, bichon-blob, memdb) with no external database
Content deduplication by BLAKE3 hash, with attachments stored separately and the original EML reconstructable byte-for-byte
Metrics-only API tokens for Prometheus scraping
Imports from EML, MBOX (including Gmail variant), Thunderbird, and PST
caveats: Data directories must be on a local filesystem; NFS/SMB and similar network storage can cause corruption
Default admin password is admin@bichon and must be changed after first login
Re-encrypting stored secrets after changing BICHON_ENCRYPT_PASSWORD is not yet supported
Enterprise SSO, S3-compatible storage and an MCP server are listed as unfinished roadmap items
